assertions.name: q_integer_truncates_at_root_of_unity
assertions.source: [κ]_q = 0 exactly at q = e^{iπ/κ} for every κ in 2..8 — the WRT/Verlinde truncation that makes the q-Laplacian spectrum finite and exact at roots of unity.

assertions.name: golden_ratio_at_kappa5
assertions.source: [3]_q at q=e^{iπ/5} equals the golden ratio φ=(1+√5)/2, the Fibonacci-anyon quantum dimension — the truncated spectrum is exact ADE/Verlinde data.

description: Exact root-of-unity truncation of the q-integer eigenvalue tower [k]_q — the shared spectral engine of the q-Laplacian (q-heat ∂_t=−Δ_q, q-Navier-Stokes Δ_q) and the Wenzl/Gram-matrix block dimensions. At q=e^{iπ/κ} the q-integer [κ]_q vanishes (WRT/Verlinde truncation), making the infinite q-Laplacian spectrum FINITE and exact. Records the surviving quantum dimensions [1]_q..[κ−1]_q (incl. the golden ratio at κ=5 = Fibonacci anyon dim), the q-heat mode-decay rates [k]_q², the involutions (bar q↦q⁻¹ fixes [k]_q; index k↦−k flips it ⇒ [k]_q² index-even = physical), and the Yekutieli obstruction-level cap (κ−1) from the same truncation (4 survey targets: q-heat, q-NS, Gram/Wenzl, Yekutieli). Fibre-level (q formal, Im unconstrained); reality only at q₀. Exact symbolic; characterizes the shared engine, does not solve the q-NS PDE or build the q-heat archimedean realisation.

involutions.note: two distinct involutions: bar q↦q⁻¹ fixes [k]_q; index k↦−k flips its sign, making [k]_q² index-even (the charge-conjugation-symmetric spectral weight).

q_heat_decay_rates_kappa5.note: [k]_q² mode-decay rates; finite heat kernel at the root

yekutieli_obstruction_cap.mechanism: at q=e^{iπ/κ} only j=0..(κ−2)/2 survive ⇒ Yekutieli obstruction tower κ_n capped at level (κ−1); the q-difference / Verlinde handle on the abstract cohomological obstruction
yekutieli_obstruction_cap.bring_substrate: genus-4, χ(A)=−6; 3 lepton generations = cyclotomic-Galois orbits of S_3⊂S_5 on 6 branch points
